shots.say: Today is Mama's birthday. And Tumble has no present!
I'm Milo! Come on a big adventure with us!
This is Tumble, the baby elephant, and this is his mama.
Mama Elephant is one year older today. Happy birthday, Mama!
Mama is big, and gentle, and kind.
Mama loves sweet, golden fruit. I want to find her the biggest one!
The best golden fruit grows far away, at the top of the tallest tree.
So far? How will we get there, Milo?
I know the way. Look at my map!
We must cross a river, climb a tree, and walk over a hill.
Let's go, Tumble! We must be back before the sun goes down.
They walk and walk. Then, oh! A wide river is in the way.
It is too deep! I can not jump across.
Hmm. What can Tumble do? Jump over, or use his trunk?
I know! My trunk!
Tumble walks into the water, and lifts his trunk up high.
He breathes through his trunk, just like a snorkel!
An elephant can use its trunk like a snorkel in deep water.
Can you lift your arm up high, like a trunk? Up, up, up!
Trunks up! I did it!
Hooray, Tumble! You are so brave.
Into the green jungle they go.
The trees are so tall. The leaves are so big!
There it is! The tallest tree. And the golden fruit, at the very top.
I will reach it with my trunk. Stretch!
But the fruit is much too high.
I can fly up here. But the fruit is too heavy for a little bird!
Hello down there! Do you need a hand? Or a tail?
It is Mango, the spider monkey! She hangs upside down by her tail.
I know all about fruit. Fruit is what I eat the most!
A spider monkey's tail can hold on, just like an extra hand.
Swing-a-ding! Here I go!
Mango holds the branch with her tail, and picks the fruit with both hands.
How many hands does Mango use? One, two. And one tail!
Here you go, Tumble. One golden fruit for your mama!
Thank you, Mango! Will you come to the party?
Yes, please! I love a party.
The way home goes over a big, sandy hill.
Step, sink. Step, sink. Tumble's heavy feet sink into the soft sand.
Puff, puff. The fruit is so heavy, and the hill is so high.
And look! The sun is going down.
Hello, friends! I am Sandy. Sand is easy for me!
A camel's wide feet spread out, so they do not sink in the sand.
Put the fruit on my back, Tumble. Step, step, step!
Thank you, Sandy! You are a good friend.
Up the hill they go, all together.
But at the top of the hill, bump!
The golden fruit rolls away. Down, down, down the hill.
Splat. The fruit is squashed.
Oh no. Now I have no present for Mama.
Tumble feels very sad. His friends come close.
Tumble is sad. What could help him feel better?
It is okay to feel sad, Tumble. We are here with you.
Look, Tumble! There is something inside the fruit.
It is a seed! A seed can grow into a new tree.
A tree with golden fruit, for Mama, every single year!
What a wonderful idea, Tumble!
Tumble picks up the tiny seed with the tip of his trunk. So gently!
Back at the zoo, the sun is low and golden.
Tumble digs a little hole.
Mango drops in the seed. Sandy pats the sand.
And Tumble sprays it with water. Whoosh!
Tumble! What are you making?
Happy birthday, Mama! It is a fruit tree. It will grow and grow, just for you.
Happy birthday, Mama Elephant!
Oh, Tumble. This is the best present of all.
Mama wraps her trunk around Tumble. A big, warm trunk hug.
I love you, Mama.
I love you too, my little Tumble.
One day, this little tree will be as tall as Mama.
A present made with friends is the best present of all.
Do you remember? Who used a trunk like a snorkel? Tumble, or Mango?
Friends help friends. Hooray, hooray! What a big adventure day!
See you on the next adventure, friends!
